name: Barbell Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and press a barbell straight overhead with a shoulder-width or slightly narrower overhand grip.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly while tucking your upper arms close alongside your ears.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower the bar behind your head until you feel a deep stretch in your triceps.
Extend your elbows forcefully to press the bar smoothly back overhead without shifting your upper arms.
tips: Brace your abdomen and keep your ribs down so your lower back stays neutral.
Keep your elbows pointed upward rather than letting them flare far out to the sides.
